definitions: def modulus: nat = $ x1 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 $;
def uadd (a b: nat): nat = $ (a + b) % modulus $;
def umul (a b: nat): nat = $ (a * b) % modulus $;
def wmax: nat = $ x7 :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf $;
def wmin: nat = $ x8 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 $;
claim_descriptor.input_domain: Every natural number for each theorem binder. Each I64 input embeds as its unsigned residue below 2^64.
claim_descriptor.observable_outputs: Every ordered output of both graphs

propositions.declaration: theorem endpoint_small (a: nat): $ 3 : 5 : umul a (uadd 3 5) : 0 = 3 : 5 : umul a 8 : 0 $;
propositions.subject: small

propositions.declaration: theorem endpoint_boundary (a: nat): $ wmax : 1 : umul a (uadd wmax 1) : 0 = wmax : 1 : umul a wmin : 0 $;
propositions.subject: boundary

propositions.declaration: theorem fold_boundary: $ (x7 :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf) + 1 = (x8 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0) $;

claim_descriptor.quantifiers: One universally quantified nat binder per graph input slot, with no hypothesis.

representation_relation.outputs: All ordered outputs as one cons list that ends in 0

assumed: Closed numerals denote natural numbers in the standard model of the pinned Peano axioms: d0, suc, add, mul, and the h2n digit axioms.
Equality of two cons lists means equality of every ordered output. Cons injectivity is not checked in this run.
The abstract definitions div and mod mean Euclidean division, as the checked divmod and modlt theorems constrain them.
ngraph-sem/0 reads i64.add and i64.mul as 64-bit wrapping operations and input k as slot k.
The pinned mm0-c source, the pinned GCC build, glibc, the kernel, and the hardware execute the check correctly.
checked: The pinned parser-enabled mm0-c checked every theorem of the flattened specification against the presented MMB proof in this run.
The specification is the exact flattening of the caller theory and the pinned upstream base theory.
Every axiom equals an approved declaration of the pinned base theory, and no axiom proves an arbitrary proposition.
The caller definitions, the interpretation operations, and the required theorems equal their frozen declarations.
The adapter decoded the exact subject bytes, replayed every certified fold, and matched each stated endpoint and fold claim.
The closure is the canonical pinned Nix derivation, and the checker binary has the qualified digest.
unresolved: No checked representation argument connects this MM0 model to the Noble Lean denotation.
The graph-to-term projection and the subject decoder are adapter code, not proved code.
Correspondence with the Rust certificate checker, compiler lowering, emitted Wasm, and runtime remains unproved.
